brief: The egg stall in the lane, empty baskets lined along a trestle, a crowd's worth of baskets on the ground.
A meadow of jackalopes sitting still, a lone straw hat on the track.
Wagon bells hanging along a wagon rail, moths glowing on a few.
A lone wagon with a wheel sunk in a rut at the end of a lane, hedges just ahead, a long steering pole.
A tunnel of tall knotted reeds over dark water, swinging shut and open like doors.
A flat marsh raft bumped by a swarm of tiny pale wisps, hanging moss, a ribbon strung overhead.
The raft at dusk in thickening fog, a lantern hook at the bow, a pole at the stern.
A slow river with a drifting stump like a sleeping cow, fog, the Hollow Gate faint in the distance.
A ring of boot-high saplings in a clearing, leaves rustling.
A hedge knitting its branches into a neat green gate with one thorny latch.
A patch of gray moss at the edge of a green one, a strawberry patch behind.
A dry glade with a small clear spring in a mossy dip, a hollow leaf for a cup.
Three big ferns in a row, dappled light.
An enormous old beech with a knot-hole and a branch for a squirrel to sit on.
The MossHome archive doorstep: springy welcome moss, a round door, shelves seen through it.
A table with a ball of yarn, a fistful of thorns, and a cloth map to pin them on.
A tall tilted chair that will not stand up, string and a ruler laid beside it.
A swaying rope bridge with a gap, a stack of spare planks tied to the rail with a tag.
The runners' post: a hollow stump for news cords, pegs of knotted cords.
A runner's hands (no figure) tying a cord against a MossHome wall, a bundle of cords.
The halfway hut: a shelf of honeycakes, a path-keeper's tin on the counter.
Slick stepping stones up a cliff stream, waves rolling down in a rhythm.
A flat rock at the edge of the foothills at the last of the sun, bare and a little cold.
The tally house floor with a big chalked map, four clue objects set on it.
A long wall of pry bars hung on pegs by turned-back prospectors, a line of them climbing the hill.
A hand bell on a little cart with a wheel stuck in a rut on the way down to the boundary stones.
The bell house's long table at supper, a pot of honey the size of a head.
The bell house at night: rows of bells hung low, cloths, a lamp.
A hillside slope with three flat rocks, one cracked, a single bright glow.
The road at the foot of the slope, a lead wagon with a dropped wheel in a deep rut, forty wagons queueing behind it.
The edge of the camp at dusk: a hundred tents, Hessa's heavy soup pots on trestles.
A baker's stall by a bench, flour, warm honeycakes in a basket.
Pellam's table: a bucket-sized kettle, thimble-sized cups, a plate of shortbread.
A glass cabinet of forty stones on a cart, one wheel stuck in a rut.
A checkpoint table with a stamp, boxes piled beside it, a long shelf by the road.
The mountain hairpin with a line of slow wagons rolling around it.
A flat rock on a mountain path with a pencil beside it.
An old door laid across two barrels in the middle of the Pinch.
A row of painted masks hung on posts, a leader's mask tapped.
Two lines of fires, wardens' side and masks' side, a stack of tin mugs at the near one.
Tall stacks of numbered boxes leaning and sliding down a bend toward waiting sacks.
A road with runaway stones rolling across it, sacks lined up at the far side.
A dragonling way-shelter's gate, a board for stacking, a paper bag of honeycakes.
A hillside still letting go, small red stones trickling across the road in bursts.
A caravan coming around a hairpin, harness bells ringing, a tired lead wagon.
The inside of a warden hut: a nibbled code card, a bell rope.
A slope with a washed-out step, a cart parked across it, bundles piled.
A warden post with a tin on a shelf, a sign-in book.
A steep chimney of warm rock with a hanging rope and a painted sign.
